authorization: On October 15, 2026 the owner approved in the working session, answering “Yes, allow it” to adding the translated paragraph to the protected privacy pages, a one-time Phase 1 scope allowance for adding the personal sky calendar's privacy paragraph to the Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, French and Italian privacy pages. This one-time exact-path exception covers only those four files and only that one paragraph, placed after the existing calendar-file paragraph in the “calendar” section: the calendar file made on the sky calendar page is built in the browser, the birth details entered there are not sent or stored, its times give the birth date and, with a birth time, the time (without one, the birthplace's time zone or, before standard time, its longitude), and it has no contacts to the ascendant or midheaven. No other text in those pages changes.
